thread:
jamal: Heads up — nightly eval 03/20 for rw-models/phi-l-3b-q4-int8 shows a sharp drop on the 'long-instruct' promptset: pass rate 72% -> 45% :rotating_light:
alex: omg, that's big. did the nightly pick up a new quant build or a new dataset?
maria: I see a deploy at 1778004200 from ci-builder with artifact tag phi-3b-q4-20260320-b3 :eyes:
jamal: correct. CI pushed a new quantized artifact after calibration. logs attached below.
jamal: ```
quantize.py --model phi-l-3b --mode int8 --calib-batch=512 --per_channel=true --seed=42
build: phi-3b-q4-20260320-b3
calib_stats: /tmp/calib-phi-3b-20260320.pkl
``` 
eva: I pulled the eval diffs. failures concentrated on long-chain reasoning and math prompts. examples:
jamal: ```
PROMPT: "Prove by induction that ..."
BASE: correct multi-step proof
NEW: hallucinated lemma, final conclusion incorrect
``` 
alex: did the quantizer change per-channel scaling? we recently merged per-channel warping in PR#1142
maria: PR#1142 included a small change: dynamic range estimation now uses running-max instead of percentile(99.999). commit cf2a9f3
jamal: suspect calibration shift — running-max over a small calibration set amplified outliers and scaled down other layers, skewing attention logits.
eva: looked at layer-wise scales. layer 7 and 12 have scale factors 6-8x larger than in previous build. token logits compressed -> top-k shifts.
ops-bot: deploybot: reverted phi-3b-q4-20260320-b3 to phi-3b-q4-20260315-b9 at 1778004350 :white_check_mark:
jamal: rollback executed, observing immediate improvement in nightly eval pass rate to 80% on short runs; long-instruct still slightly down, will continue monitoring.
alex: root cause summary (short): calibration metric change in quantizer (running-max) + small calibration sample => over-scale on some layers -> degraded instruction-following on long-answer prompts.
maria: proposed mitigations:
- revert permanent change in quantizer; keep percentile-based range with configurable percentile
- increase calibration sample diversity (add long-instruction pivot set)
- add gating rule: nightly eval must not reg drop >8% vs baseline for any promptset
- add canary rollout: 1% traffic for new quant builds with real-time eval checks
- add automated layer-scale sanity check: if any scale > 4x baseline, fail build
jamal: created ticket RW-ML-712 (assign @maria) for quantizer fix and RW-ML-713 for calibration tooling.
eva: also adding an explicit regression check in model-onboarding pipeline: compare top-k token overlap for a small set of reasoning prompts.
alex: schedule: hotfix to rollback quantizer change to land today, new calibration run with expanded pivot set tomorrow, gating and canary infra by EOD Friday.
ops-bot: incidentbot: postmortem label applied, severity: medium, action items logged.
maria: quick note — we should avoid running running-max unless calib set > 10k tokens. for now we'll gate that option.
jamal: thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a short writeup and link the tickets. :thumbsup:
dev-bot: Created docs: /docs/quantization/calibration-guidelines.md
jamal: copying the eval diffs and a repro script into RW-ML-712 for PR review.
alex: good catch, team. closing the immediate alert. monitoring for regressions.
